sources.read_extent: All six physical pages; Article 2 physical page 3 visually checked
sources.check_performed: Article 1 inserts clesrovimab alongside nirsevimab. Existing under-one single-supply and authorisation restrictions persist. Rationale preserves ordinary SGB V rights. Commencement is the day after promulgation. German market availability since June is explicit.

sources.read_extent: SGB V 20i(1)–(3) operative clauses, 130e(1)–(3), 10(1)–(3); IfSG 2(9)–(10),20(2); original RSV ordinance one page

sources.title: KBV/GKV Annex 4a, 1 July 2026
sources.check_performed: Substitute procedure covers under-18 patients missing card and electronic replacement. Insurer/identity details and signed confirmation of cover remain required, with a special unaccompanied-child signature exception. Private treatment fees after ten days and refund by quarter-end concern proof; private prescription incidence and pharmacy-refund practice are not quantified.
sources.temporal_limit: Operative July version predates responses; older public overview mentioning only under-three-month infants is not substituted. Proof absence and true unresolved eligibility remain distinct.

sources.title: EMA Enflonsia EPAR and June product information
sources.read_extent: Overview indication/benefit/risk/date; product information physical pages 2–10, sections 4.1–4.8,5.1–5.2
sources.check_performed: EU authorisation is 15 April 2026, first-season infant RSV lower-respiratory disease prevention. One 105 mg dose; efficacy evaluated through 150 days. Placebo-controlled Study 004 and palivizumab-controlled Study 007 are not nirsevimab head-to-head trials. Acceptable benefit-risk includes low-weight/extreme-prematurity data limits and hypersensitivity warnings. F-protein target confirmed.
sources.temporal_limit: June information predates responses. Protection is risk reduction, not perfect or sterilising immunity; no safety inference for every subgroup.

sources.title: Danish Medicines Council, 27 May 2026 assessment
sources.read_extent: Physical pages 2,4,48–50,57–58 and dated decision clinical rationale
sources.check_performed: Council accepts clinical equivalence for assessed infant populations. Bucher indirect placebo-anchored comparisons use gestational-age subgroups and post-hoc matched endpoints. Fewer events, less clesrovimab evidence and high-risk efficacy uncertainty remain. No direct comparative trial. The broad clinical-alternative wording is supported with these limits.
sources.temporal_limit: Pre-author assessment. Danish maternal programme/economic subgroup eligibility is not German reimbursement law.

sources.temporal_limit: Predates all responses. Recommendations and general statutory entitlement remain distinct.

sources.title: RKI January 2024 RSV guide
sources.check_performed: RSV A/B, near-universal infection by end of second year, incomplete immunity and common reinfection confirmed. Mild/asymptomatic reinfections particularly describe adults; children can have recurrent lower-respiratory disease. Infant and older/adversely affected adult burden supported.
sources.temporal_limit: Dated pre-author guide; seasonal peaks are not the same definition as outer clinical-planning bounds.

sources.title: RKI 31 July 2025 surveillance
sources.check_performed: Infant outpatient consultations and hospital RSV burden declined in first broad-prophylaxis season. Sentinel methods, testing/coding changes and shorter wave limit causal attribution. Supports substantial burden reduction with plausible preventive contribution; no exact national causal fraction established.
sources.temporal_limit: Before response. Observational national surveillance is not a randomised population intervention trial.

sources.title: DGPK primary-society copy of RSV guideline, September 2024 amendment
sources.read_extent: Header identity and complete physical pages 65–66, section 4.6 / 4.6.1, through primary indexed PDF text
sources.check_performed: Exact German mid-October–end-December and end-March–end-June ranges appear. Section explains outer planning maxima, quartiles, threshold uncertainty and regional variation. European seasons usually last four to six winter months, with no uniform start/end recommendation. Supports approximate author planning claims, not a fixed surveillance definition.

sources.title: Li et al. Lancet 2022 global RSV burden analysis
sources.read_extent: Physical pages 1–2 identity/abstract,5 methods and14 mortality/discussion
sources.check_performed: 2019 model estimate is 101,400 overall RSV-attributable deaths in children under five, uncertainty 84,500–125,200. Distinct from 26,300 in-hospital deaths. Study pools 481 studies and models community mortality; children in author context is a reasonable approximation, not a German or all-age observed count.
sources.temporal_limit: Modelled 2019 burden, not current realised death registry. No claim all deaths are in infants under one.

sources.title: EMA RSV vaccine and antibody overviews
sources.read_extent: Beyfortus and Synagis overview indication/use/mechanism/date; Abrysvo,Arexvy,mResvia overview and authorisation metadata
sources.check_performed: Three RSV antibodies include high-risk monthly palivizumab; broad one-dose long-acting first-season options are two. Three adult vaccines exist; Abrysvo includes maternal protection. Antibodies target F protein. Current age expansions are not substituted for historical broad existence claims.
sources.temporal_limit: Only needed product count, broad scope, mechanism and original approval checked. Not every current age expansion certified at September date.

sources.read_extent: Targeted official BMG/G-BA/GKV and manufacturer searches; author cost scenario recomputed
sources.check_performed: No exact-date matched German net GKV price pair recovered. Sixty euros times 600,000 doses is 36 million euros. Foreign public prices, later hospital add-on tariffs and current package prices are not substituted.
